newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba, RWE ink telecoms venture.
newsitem.headline: Veba, RWE ink telecoms venture.

text.p: German utilities Veba AG and RWE AG said on Thursday they had officially signed founding documents for their o.tel.o telecommunications joint venture, plans for which were announced recently.
o.tel.o said in a statement that its business strategy would be presented on March 13 at the Cebit computer and communications trade fair in Hanover.

Veba will own 40 percent of o.tel.o and RWE 37.5 percent. The remaining 22.5 percent, earmarked for Britain's Cable & Wireless Plc before it pulled out of cooperation talks, will be held in trust by a bank until a new partner is found.
